# Original Candidate Description

The original `student.agent.md` file before optimization. Used as the baseline for comparison.

## Known failure modes (from engineering review)

1. No evidence reading order before revision
2. Approval prediction criteria are subjective (no checklist)
3. Engineer handoff trigger is ambiguous ("when the task needs specialized coaching")
4. No hard turn cap for self-checking loop
5. Validation step unspecified ("run the relevant validation step")
6. No guidance for absent/missing STEERING.md
